intro: Trying to find Ohio scholarships in the USA that consider financial need and stay on the lower award side can be more useful than scanning broad national lists. This filtered slice brings together programs with smaller listed awards, which can still help cover books, fees, supplies, or part of tuition when combined with other aid. The rows below span different subjects and applicant types, including community, education, law, medicine, and STEM related options. Requirements are not identical across these listings: some may ask for essays, some may be lighter to apply for, and eligibility ScholarshipTop organizes available details as part of application planning by program. Deadlines also vary by row, so it makes sense to compare them early and review eligibility signals and provider-path context on the provider application path before you apply.

Read the requirement lines closely, note whether the scholarship is tied to Ohio residency, a specific field such as education, law, health professions, engineering, or physical sciences, and check the study level that fits your situation. Because these are smaller award listings, they are often worth shortlisting alongside larger scholarships rather than instead of them.
